bridge.scope: Contributor-scoped semantic ingestion and retrieval of Open Period Care Knowledge Cards with preserved evidence state

environment.description: MyZubster structured evidence and contributor-scoped semantic retrieval path

steps: Fetch and normalize the public Open Period Care evidence package.
Ingest contributor-scoped structured evidence into the semantic bridge.
Query for the contributor Knowledge Cards.
Verify KC-OPC-001 and KC-OPC-002 are returned with SUPPORTED state.
Verify the credential boundary prevents unsupported personal-certification claims.

observation.summary: Contributor-scoped semantic retrieval returned the expected Open Period Care Knowledge Cards with their research evidence state preserved.

limitations: SUPPORTED research evidence is not promoted to TESTED scientific or clinical evidence.
This checkpoint does not establish medical or clinical certification.
Knowledge Card publication and Contributor Passport publication remain separate account-side actions.
